text_en: Satan stood up against Israel, and incited David to count the people of Israel.
text_cn: 撒殚起来反对以色列，怂恿达味统计以色列：

text_en: So David said to Joab and the commanders of the army, “Go, number Israel, from Beer-sheba to Dan, and bring me a report, so that I may know their number. ”
text_cn: 达味对约阿布及人民的首领说：“你们去统计以色列，由贝尔舍巴直到丹，然后回来告诉我，叫我知道他们的数目。”

text_en: But Joab said, “May the Lord increase the number of his people a hundredfold! Are they not, my lord the king, all of them my lord’s servants? Why then should my lord require this? Why should he bring guilt on Israel? ”
text_cn: 约阿布回答说：“愿上主使自己的百姓比现在更增加百倍！我主大王，他们不都是我主的仆人吗？我主为什么硬要这样作？为什么要使以色列陷于罪恶？”

text_en: But the king’s word prevailed against Joab. So Joab departed and went throughout all Israel, and came back to Jerusalem.
text_cn: 然而君王的命令迫使约阿布；约阿布便去，走遍了全以色列，然后回到耶路撒冷，

text_en: Joab gave the total count of the people to David. In all Israel there were one million one hundred thousand men who drew the sword, and in Judah four hundred seventy thousand who drew the sword.
text_cn: 将统计人民的数目呈报给达味：全以色列能持刀的人有一百一十万，犹大人能持刀的有四十七万。

text_en: But he did not include Levi and Benjamin in the numbering, for the king’s command was abhorrent to Joab.
text_cn: 唯有肋未人及本雅明人没有统计，因为约阿布憎厌君王的命令。

text_en: But God was displeased with this thing, and he struck Israel.
text_cn: 这事使天主不悦，遂打击了以色列。

text_en: David said to God, “I have sinned greatly in that I have done this thing. But now, I pray you, take away the guilt of your servant; for I have done very foolishly. ”
text_cn: 达味对天主说：“我作这事，实在犯了重罪。现在，求你赦免你仆人的罪，因为我所行的实在昏愚。”

text_en: The Lord spoke to Gad, David’s seer, saying,
text_cn: 上主晓谕达味的先见者加得说：

text_en: “Go and say to David, ‘Thus says the Lord : Three things I offer you; choose one of them, so that I may do it to you. ’”
text_cn: “你去告诉达味：上主这样说：我给你提出三件事，任你选择一件，我好向你实行。”

text_en: So Gad came to David and said to him, “Thus says the Lord , ‘Take your choice:
text_cn: 加得来到达味前，对他说：“上主这样说：任你选择：

text_en: either three years of famine; or three months of devastation by your foes, while the sword of your enemies overtakes you; or three days of the sword of the Lord , pestilence on the land, and the angel of the Lord destroying throughout all the territory of Israel. ’ Now decide what answer I shall return to the one who sent me. ”
text_cn: 或者三年饥荒；或者三个月在你敌人前流亡，为敌人持刀追击；或者三日在你国内遭受上主的刀，即瘟疫，让上主的使者蹂躏以色列全境。现在你考虑一下，我应向那派遣我来的回复什么！”

text_en: Then David said to Gad, “I am in great distress; let me fall into the hand of the Lord , for his mercy is very great; but let me not fall into human hands. ”
text_cn: 达味对加得说：“我很作难，但我宁愿落在上主手中，因为他富于仁慈，而不愿落在人手中。”

text_en: So the Lord sent a pestilence on Israel; and seventy thousand persons fell in Israel.
text_cn: 于是上主使瘟疫降于以色列；在以色列因瘟疫死了七万人。

text_en: And God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it; but when he was about to destroy it, the Lord took note and relented concerning the calamity; he said to the destroying angel, “Enough! Stay your hand. ” The angel of the Lord was then standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
text_cn: 当时，天主派一位天使往耶路撒冷去，要毁灭那城；将要毁灭的时候，上主一看，便后悔降灾，遂吩咐毁灭的天使说：“够了，现在收回你的手吧！”那时，上主的天使正立在耶步斯人敖尔难的禾场上。

text_en: David looked up and saw the angel of the Lord standing between earth and heaven, and in his hand a drawn sword stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell on their faces.
text_cn: 达味举目，见上主的使者立在天地中间，手持脱鞘的刀，朝向耶路撒冷。达味与众长老都身穿麻衣，俯伏在地。

text_en: And David said to God, “Was it not I who gave the command to count the people? It is I who have sinned and done very wickedly. But these sheep, what have they done? Let your hand, I pray, O Lord my God, be against me and against my father’s house; but do not let your people be plagued! ”
text_cn: 达味对天主说：“不是我下了令统计百姓么？是我犯了罪，是我这个牧者作了恶。但这羊群作了什么？上主，我的天主！愿你的手打击我和我的父家，但不要将瘟疫降在你百姓身上！”

text_en: Then the angel of the Lord commanded Gad to tell David that he should go up and erect an altar to the Lord on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
text_cn: 上主的天使吩咐加得去告诉达味，叫他上去，在耶步斯人敖尔难的禾场上，为上主建立一座祭坛。

text_en: So David went up following Gad’s instructions, which he had spoken in the name of the Lord .
text_cn: 达味就照加得奉上主的名所说的话上去了。

text_en: Ornan turned and saw the angel; and while his four sons who were with him hid themselves, Ornan continued to thresh wheat.
text_cn: 敖尔难回头看见君王和他的四个儿子经过；那时敖尔难正在打麦子。

text_en: As David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David; he went out from the threshing floor, and did obeisance to David with his face to the ground.
text_cn: 达味走到敖尔难那里，敖尔难一看见是达味，便走出禾场，俯首至地叩拜达味。

text_en: David said to Ornan, “Give me the site of the threshing floor that I may build on it an altar to the Lord —give it to me at its full price—so that the plague may be averted from the people. ”
text_cn: 达味对敖尔难说：“请将这块禾场地段让给我，我要在这禾场上为上主建立一座祭坛，请照足价让给我，为止息民间的灾祸。”

text_en: Then Ornan said to David, “Take it; and let my lord the king do what seems good to him; see, I present the oxen for burnt offerings, and the threshing sledges for the wood, and the wheat for a grain offering. I give it all. ”
text_cn: 敖尔难对达味说：“尽管用吧！我主大王看着好，就去行罢！看，我将牛给你作全燔祭，打禾具作木柴，麦子作素祭：这一切我都供给你。”

text_en: But King David said to Ornan, “No; I will buy them for the full price. I will not take for the Lord what is yours, nor offer burnt offerings that cost me nothing. ”
text_cn: 达味对敖尔难说：“不成！我一定要照足价来买；我不能拿你的东西献于上主，不能用没有代价的东西，献作全燔祭。”

text_en: So David paid Ornan six hundred shekels of gold by weight for the site.
text_cn: 于是，达味为那块地付给敖尔难六百“协刻耳”重的金子。

text_en: David built there an altar to the Lord and presented burnt offerings and offerings of well-being. He called upon the Lord , and he answered him with fire from heaven on the altar of burnt offering.
text_cn: 达味在那里为上主建立了一座祭坛，奉献了全燔祭与和平祭，呼求了上主，上主由天上垂听了他，使火降在全燔祭坛上，

text_en: Then the Lord commanded the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath.
text_cn: 并命天使将刀收入鞘中。

text_en: At that time, when David saw that the Lord had answered him at the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, he made his sacrifices there.
text_cn: 那时，达味见上主在耶步斯人敖尔难的禾场上垂听了他，就在那里献了祭。──

text_en: For the tabernacle of the Lord , which Moses had made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt offering were at that time in the high place at Gibeon;
text_cn: 梅瑟在旷野所造的会幕和全燔祭坛，那时虽都在基贝红高处；

text_en: but David could not go before it to inquire of God, for he was afraid of the sword of the angel of the Lord .
text_cn: 但达味不敢前去求问天主，因为害怕上主使者的刀。
